definitions.full: H94. Agur אָגוּר proper name, masculine (perhaps hireling , Arabic , Aramaic אֲגִירָא , see PS, Assyrian agîru , compare Hpt BAS i. 124 ; others gatherer , from I. אגר ) son of יָקֶה , an author of proverbs Prov 30:1 .
